action_beats: The sealed IKEA box sits dead-center on the bare ash floor in total stillness under morning sunlight. | At second 03, the box begins to shudder rapidly with high-frequency tactile micro-vibrations. | At second 07, the reinforced packing tape along the top center seam suddenly splits open with a crisp pop and a tiny puff of kraft paper dust.

The cardboard flaps fold flat onto the floor like blooming origami petals. | Precision-cut solid oak furniture legs, white shelf panels, and frame components levitate out in structured order. | Components interlock at high velocity into a low coffee table and a minimalist shelving unit with rigid mechanical clicks.

A textured grey fabric sofa expands smoothly from the center staging area, cushions billowing outward. | A woven natural wool area rug unrolls across the ash floor with rhythmic momentum. | A ceramic table lamp and a potted green fiddle-leaf fig slide gracefully onto their finished surfaces.

A folded mustard-yellow waffle-knit wool throw blanket arcs gracefully through the air over the sofa. | The blanket lands dead-center on the grey sofa corner, sending a soft, visible air ripple through its knit folds. | All motion abruptly freezes into an immaculate, serene, fully furnished architectural living room.
